column1: # S3.D mutation trigger — must-match / must-not-match case table.
# S3.D's table has three rows. Rows 1 (guard-shaped files) and 2 (Rust source) differ in
# whether the RESULT blocks — 100% kill versus advisory — not in whether the consultation
# is owed. Row 3 (docs / non-code) is the only untriggered one. So one predicate answers
# the only question the guard asks: is `not-triggered` a lie on this diff.
# `unreachable` stays open as the honest path when mutation cannot be run; it is
# DEGRADED, and DEGRADED proceeds on a feature branch (S7).
